note: Inputs for the A4 energy/latency ESTIMATES. Only figures read directly from a primary source in this session are included. Labelled estimates, not measurements.

verified.source: M. Horowitz, 'Computing's energy problem (and what we can do about it)', ISSCC 2014, Session 1.1, pp. 10-14, Fig. 1.1.9 'Rough energy costs for various operations in 45nm 0.9V'
verified.how_verified: PDF downloaded and Fig. 1.1.9 read visually (page 14 of the digest)
verified.caveat: 45 nm ASIC-class figures; a 90 nm / 40 nm MCU spends far more per operation once instruction fetch and control are included (the paper's own 70 pJ/instruction in-order figure). tanh is not tabulated; the arena estimate must state its assumption.

verified.source: STMicroelectronics STM32G474xB/xC/xE datasheet DS12288 Rev 2 (Oct 2019), section 5.3.5 Supply current characteristics, Table 21 'Current consumption in Run and Low-power run modes, code with data processing running from Flash in single Bank, ART enable (Cache ON Prefetch OFF)', symbol IDD(Run), p. 87/234 of that PDF
verified.url_read: https://docs.rs-online.com/2131/A700000006432374.pdf (RS Components mirror of the ST PDF; sha256 of the file as fetched ed8421b707da6daa833107d34b5d350d2df984fb62922aefae8d2a7fb13d4cd5; text extracted with pdftotext)
verified.conditions: fHCLK = fHSE up to 48 MHz (bypass), PLL ON above 48 MHz, all peripherals disabled, all I/O analog, flash wait states minimal, Range 1 Boost mode for 150 < fHCLK <= 170 MHz, Range 1 Normal for 26 < fHCLK <= 150 MHz; typical at 25 C (table lists 25/55/85/105/125 C; no explicit VDD in the table, ST's general conditions)
verified.caveat: Rev 2 of the datasheet; later revisions (Rev 5/6) were not read and could differ. The generic code in this table is ST's test code, not the arena kernels (Cortex-M4F, no int8/SIMD assumptions). The older ST slide numbers (173/163 uA/MHz) agree with the derived values. Core plus flash only, excludes board/regulator losses.
